QUICKBATTLEMAP.DropInstructions: Drop a background image or video, and optionally a JSON file with walls and lights.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.DropInstructionsMore: If no JSON is provided, the module can try to auto-detect grid size from the image. You can also create a scene with no grid. Universal VTT maps (.dd2vtt, .df2vtt, .uvtt) go on the Universal VTT tab.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.MissingFiles: A background image or video is required
QUICKBATTLEMAP.InvalidJSON: The JSON file could not be parsed
QUICKBATTLEMAP.NoGridHint: Skips applying or detecting a grid. Useful for maps without visible grid lines.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ProgressNote: Shows ongoing tasks like uploading and auto-detecting grid size.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can import battlemaps.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.UniversalInstructions: Import a Universal VTT map from Dungeondraft, DungeonFog, Arkenforge, or AutoWall.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.FrameMapsHint: Draws a wall rectangle around every map when they are combined into one image.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.LevelsNote: Each file becomes its own scene level. The scene uses the largest map.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.DetailHint: How many bends to keep on cave walls. Left is fewer walls. Right keeps every bend.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.DetailWarning: High wall detail can create a very large number of walls.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.NudgeHint: Shifts cave walls sideways, in grid cells. Leave at 0 when the walls already line up. Negative values shift the other way.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ObjectWallsHint: Also import walls from objects that block sight.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PaddingHint: Empty margin around the map, as a fraction of the scene size.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.CustomCellHint: Resize the exported image instead of using the pixels-per-cell value stored in the file.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.WebpHint: WebP files are smaller. Encoding them takes longer.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.WebpQualityHint: Higher quality uses more disk space.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PathHint: Folder relative to User Data, for example worlds/yourworld/quick-battlemap.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PathWarning: Use a folder relative to User Data, such as worlds/yourworld/quick-battlemap.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.BucketRequired: Choose an S3 bucket when storage is S3.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ReadFailed: Could not read the selected files
QUICKBATTLEMAP.NoMaps: Choose at least one Universal VTT file.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.SkipFile: Skipped a file that could not be read
QUICKBATTLEMAP.AttachFailed: The dropped file could not be attached. Choose it with the file button instead.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.CellSizeReduced: Pixels per cell reduced from {from} to {to} so the image fits in the browser.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.WindowsAreDoorsHint: Import every portal as a door. When this is off, portals that do not block light are imported as windows.
